exposure: Cervical position (anterior or posterior to a line perpendicular to the anatomical conjugate on MRI)
Cervical position on MRI (anteverted vs retroverted)
Cervical canal angle (<=10 degrees or >10 degrees)
cohort: 96 patients with placenta previa who underwent a preoperative MRI examination of placenta accreta spectrum
finding: The adhesion rate was significantly higher in patients with a retroverted cervix than those with an anteverted cervix (8.5% vs. 60%; p = 0.00).
